images.alt: Four fictional adult women link hands on a protected overlook above the layered beige walls of Makhtesh Ramon. They wear blue-silver, black-and-cream, rust-silver and white-coral outfits with contrasting boots. The woman at right kisses the smiling blonde woman's cheek.

Four fictional adult women stand hand in hand below Soligorsk's towering terraced salt mountains and a conveyor. Burgundy, cobalt-black, white-blue and green-silver outfits pair with contrasting boots. The central woman lifts a foot among salt flecks as the two women at right lean close.

An extreme-wide view of four fictional adult women huddled on a timber boardwalk amid the Karakum's rippled golden dunes under a dramatic blue sky. Their red-black, ivory-gold, emerald and turquoise-black outfits contrast with the sand, and a turquoise sash streams sideways.

A high, wide view of four fictional adult women gathered on a colorful geometric mosaic plaza among Ghadames-inspired adobe homes and arcades, palms and distant desert mesas. Ivory, saffron, blue and black-red outfits form a small linked group, with a saffron sash caught by the breeze.
